gaps.title: Tesla AUNZ: FSD Supervised logs 160 million km in first year with local safety scorecard
gaps.whyItMightMatter: Official AU/NZ anniversary: ~160 million km of Supervised FSD vs ~2.4 billion km manual-with-Active-Safety baseline, claiming 40% fewer collisions and 66% fewer AEB events. First RHD markets; HW3 Lite for AU/NZ still unpublished. Tesla did not split AU vs NZ or subscription counts.

gaps.title: Tesla deploys first Accordion Supercharger: 16 factory-preassembled stalls per truck
gaps.whyItMightMatter: Tesla Charging's first Accordion site ships 16 V4 stalls on one truck, 20% cheaper install, instant commission, between-space layout when curb-behind cabinets cannot trench. Stated goal: pre-assemble every Supercharger. Comes after 2024 charging-team layoff and ~17% YoY connector growth vs 35-45% in 2020-21.
